description: Verify that TCP in ESTABLISHED ignores a duplicate ACK (RFC 793 §3.9 p72)
approach:
[Objective]
A duplicate ACK (no new data acked) carries no information — RFC 793 §3.9 says ignore. (Note: modern TCP uses dup-ACKs as a fast-retransmit signal, but that's RFC 5681's heuristic, not §3.9 EST behaviour.)

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake → ESTABLISHED.
2. Tester → DUT: ACK with same ack_num as handshake completion (no new ack).
3. Observation: DUT must NOT respond.

[Pass condition]
No DUT response to duplicate ACK.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_unexpected_response — DUT replied to dup ACK

verdicts.Pass: DUT ignored duplicate ACK in ESTABLISHED — normal
verdicts.Fail_unexpected_response: DUT response to duplicate ACK in EST
